rule: Lazy cell respawn: on load with respawn requested, if now minus a per-cell stamp exceeds 24*30*months hours, stamp now and respawn each dead creature/NPC/list with custom state once its corpse-clear or respawn delay has passed, restoring it to its placed position. Timers: per-script min-heap per clock (sim, game, real), fired each frame in order; savable timers keep a callback name, unsavable ones are lost on save. Repeat: next delay = 1.5*period - fmod(now - base + period/2, period), which snaps to the base grid without drift; first call random in [0, period).
keep: Respawn decided on zone entry, not while watching
One stamp per zone instance, not one timer per creature
Restore to the original placement point
Savable named timers versus unsavable timers as an explicit choice
Grid-snapped repeat that absorbs lateness without drift
Random first delay to spread load
change: Clock is server time, not in-game hours
Respawn is server-verified and the client only presents it
Savable timers only in our ledger; no unsavable timers
Budget enforcement must be specified (not read in donor)
look_test: Three-creature camp in a test zone. Kill it, leave, set the gate to 90 s of server time. Re-enter at 10 s (should stay empty) and at 100 s (should return on the same spots, with no message). Judge whether the return reads as the world moving on or as a cheat. Repeat with a 20 s gate.
